text_block_list.text:
The venue goes wild for Кинг Хало as
she
achieves another stunning victory in
the Yasuda
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her overwhelming skill at sprints brings
wonderful
results as she continues down
her path to
becoming her own first-rate
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She faces her fans with a big smile and
announces
her next objective: the
autumn G1 Sprinters
Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
